# Data storage API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Where session data lives, how it can be reached and how it is organized.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/datastorage/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `datastorage` (detail, create, update), `datastorages` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation/), [`datastoragemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragemembershipinvitation/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Location of the data storage, e.g., "Cabinet A", "Computer B", "Network storage C". |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the data storage is publicly available |
| `data_organization` | JSON object; nullable. The data organization of the storage, e.g., Projects → Subjects → Sessions |
| `data_protocols` | JSON object; nullable. Available data protocols for this storage location |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('datastorage', load_all=True)
records = resp['datastorages']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('datastorage', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.datastorages;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "datastorages": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Data storage 1",
            "location": "",
            "description": "",
            "is_public": true,
            "data_organization": {},
            "data_protocols": {},
            "users": null,
            "groups": null
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('datastorage', data={"name": "Data storage 1"})
record = resp.json()['datastorage']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Data storage 1'), 'datastorage');
record = created.datastorage;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('datastorage', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['datastorage']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('datastorage', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.datastorage;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "datastorage": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Data storage 1",
        "location": "",
        "description": "",
        "is_public": true,
        "data_organization": {},
        "data_protocols": {},
        "users": null,
        "groups": null
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('datastorage', id='<id>', data={"name": "Data storage 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Data storage 1 (renamed)'), 'datastorage', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/datastorage/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('datastorage', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'datastorage');
```

## JSON field schemas

Schemas for the data organization and access protocols of a data storage. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataStorage/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### Data organization

- type code `data_organization` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataStorage/data_organization/1.0.0.json)

Define the hierarchical organization of the data in this data storage, from top-level to most specific. Example: Projects → Subjects → Sessions.

This type has no type-specific properties: send an empty object. Everything meaningful is recorded on the record itself or on its material usage rows.


### Data protocols

- type code `data_protocols` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataStorage/data_protocols/1.0.0.json)

Define the available protocols for accessing this data storage. Each protocol specifies how users can connect to and retrieve data from the storage system. On your local system, you can further define a separate set of local access protocols if applicable.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `protocol` | Protocol Type: choice **[required]**; one of `Globus`, `HTTPS/Web`, `SFTP`, `FTP`, `SMB/CIFS`, `NFS`, `AFP`, `S3`, `Dropbox`, `Google Drive`, `OneDrive`, `Local Storage`, `Other`; default `"HTTPS/Web"` |
| `path` | Access Path/URL: text **[required]** |
| `is_public` | Public Access: yes/no; default `false`; format select |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "protocol": "Globus",
        "path": "text",
        "is_public": false
    }
]
```


## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Data storage data model page](/datamodel/personal_attributes/datastorage/).
